title: Floral Wedding Couple
author: litcyz
description:
Floral Wedding Couple Machine Embroidery Design 🧵💍
Capture timeless romance and artistic elegance with this breathtaking wedding couple machine embroidery design! 💍🌸✨
Featuring a delicate line-art illustration of a bride and groom embracing, highlighted by a magical flowing gown composed of intricate vine scrollwork, lush leaf tendrils, and vibrant red floral accents. This sophisticated bridal artwork brings an exquisite, boutique aesthetic to wedding keepsakes, ring bearer pillows, bridal party jackets, custom tote bags, anniversary gifts, or framed wall decor.
Frame life’s most precious moments in stitched elegance today! 🥂💖
